storyTemplate.title: Sandbox Ensemble Story
storyTemplate.description: A ensemble-romance start: arrive at a shared residence and make the first impression that will shape the household.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
Sunlit House is larger than the address made it sound.

Laughter, footsteps, and the smell of dinner drift from somewhere beyond the front door. Your room key waits in your hand, newly cut and still bright along the teeth.

Before this place can become home, you have to knock.

full_character.speech_style: Concise, grounded, helpful, and genre-aware; gives useful job details without narrating hidden mechanics.

appearance.extra_description: Genre-appropriate job board owner with a clear readable silhouette for a job-board hub.

starting_known_facts: Runs a sandbox job hub suitable for ensemble stories.
Can explain available jobs, rewards, turn-ins, and local dangers.
Exists to make optional money and side-objective play available without relying on AI-invented economy actions.
